questions.question: Which of the following art forms of Kerala is in UNESCO’s list of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3,i.e. Kutiyattam.

__
 
• **Kutiyattam__,** Sanskrit theatre, which is practised in **Kerala**, is one of India’s oldest living theatrical traditions.
 
• Originating more than 2,000 years ago, Kutiyattam represents** the local traditions of Kerala. **
 
• **Kuttampalams is one type of **Kutiyattam which is traditionally performed in theatres**,** which are located in Hindu temples.
 
• Theyyam, Chakyar Koothu and Thiruvathirakali are the art-forms of Kerala.

questions.question: Chhattisgarh does NOT share its boundary with ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. West Bengal.

questions.question: In May 2019, Prem Singh Tamang was sworn in as the Chief Minister of:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e. __Sikkim__.**

questions.question: What is the height of the Statue of Unity that is located in Gujarat?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e. __182 m.__**

questions.question: The Sunauli border is a famous transit point between India and _________.

questions.question: The Book 'Gulamgiri' was written by:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 2) i.e. __Jyotirao Phule__.**

__
 
• **Jyotirao ‘Jyotiba’ Govindrao Phule **__was a prominent social reformer and thinker of the nineteenth century India.
 
• He led the movement against the prevailing caste-restrictions in India.
 
• He revolted against the domination of the Brahmins and struggled for the rights of peasants and other low-caste people.
 
• Mahatma Jyotiba Phule was also a pioneer for women education in India and fought for the education of girls throughout his life.
 
• He is believed to be the first Hindu to start an orphanage for the unfortunate children.

questions.question: Which state has proposed to set up the first 'Blockchain District' in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 2) i.e. Telangana.**

__

questions.question: Ottamthullal is a traditional dance form that is popular in the state of ____________.

• Now it is a famous folk art presented in the temples of Kerala.

questions.question: The enzyme, Lipase is produced by which organ of the body?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. Pancreas.

__
 
• Lipase is an enzyme that splits fats so the intestines can absorb them.
 
• Lipase hydrolyses fats like triglycerides into their component fatty acid and glycerol molecules.
 
• It is secreted by **Pancreas.**__
 
• Pancreas is a composite gland which acts as both exocrine glands (contains exocrine cells ) and endocrine gland(contains endocrine cells).
 
 
• Endocrine glands secrete chemical substances into the bloodstream or tissues of the body.
 
• Exocrine glands secrete substances onto an epithelial surface by way of a duct.

questions.question: Who among the following is the author of “Principles of Political Economy”?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. __**John Stuart Mill.**__

 
• **John Stuart Mill**** **was an English philosopher, economist, and exponent of Utilitarianism.
 
• He was prominent as a publicist in the reforming age of the 19th century and remains of lasting interest as a logician and an ethical theorist.
 
• **'Principles of Political Economy**' by John Stuart Mill was one of the most important economics or political economy textbooks of the mid-nineteenth century.

questions.question: The Walayar Dam is in which district of Kerala?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3,i.e. Palakkad.

__
 
• Walayar Dam is a dam in **Palakkad district**__ of Kerala, South India.

• It was completed and opened in 1964.
 
• It is one of the major sources of irrigation in the region.

questions.question: Who among the following coined the term "battery" to describe linked capacitors?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3,i.e. Benjamin Franklin

__
 
• **Benjamin Franklin**__ was an American printer and publisher, author, inventor and scientist, and diplomat.
 
• Franklin helped draft the Declaration of Independence and was one of its signers, represented the United States in France during the American Revolution, and was a delegate to the Constitutional Convention.
 
• He made important contributions to science, especially in the understanding of electricity, and is remembered for the wit, wisdom, and elegance of his writing.
 
• He first coined the term "battery" to describe linked capacitors.

questions.question: In which of the following locations was the Global Venture Capital Summit 2018 held?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 1,i.e. __Goa.__**

__
 
• The Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP) in the Ministry of Commerce and Industry and the Government of Goa, hosted the annual Startup India Venture Capital Summit in **Goa**__ on December 07, 2018.
 
• The theme of the Summit was **‘Mobilizing Global Capital for Innovation in India**.’
 
• The event showcased the Indian startup opportunity for funds from around the world.
 
• The summit aims to attract more global capital into the country. The event enabled a dialogue between Government and experienced Venture Capital fund managers on ways to further promote the startup ecosystem in India.
